verdicts.decision_note: The client explicitly requires Ridgehaven and Harbor Valley to use separate payout configurations.
The proposed single-site Wix configuration cannot support the required location-specific payout accounts, creating a material configuration conflict.
The client-originated separate-site approach is concretely mapped to per-location Wix accounts and payment configurations; no existing payout attribute becomes stale.
The confirmed per-location Wix and payment configuration resolves the payout-architecture conflict and returns the requirement to active status.
